$comment: AWS Architecture Icons (https://aws.amazon.com/architecture/icons/): Architecture-Service-Icons_<date>/Arch_<Category>/<size>/Arch_<Service>_<size>.svg, Resource-Icons_<date>/Res_<Category>/Res_<Resource>_48[_Light|_Dark].svg, Category-Icons_<date>/Arch-Category_<size>/Arch-Category_<Category>_<size>.svg. The Arch_ / Res_ prefix, the size and the Light / Dark suffix go, the rest is kebab-cased: Arch_Amazon-EC2_64.svg -> amazon-ec2, Res_Amazon-EC2_Instance_48.svg -> amazon-ec2-instance, Arch-Category_Compute_64.svg -> category-compute. Of several sizes the largest is kept (64), of Light and Dark the Light one. No Mermaid Chart sample with aws: names was available (design Q-1): overrides map a file name (without .svg) to the icon name where Mermaid Chart's differs.
